verdict.label: GNW three-distinct-organs consensus bus — production verify, D4 real-vocab fix (rf/numpy)

preconditions.name: production-chat-built
preconditions.note: the real production ChatBrain built + the well-formed high-comprehension fact taught

preconditions.name: install-off-is-noop
preconditions.note: flag OFF -> install_three_organ_gate is a no-op (the flag genuinely gates installation)

preconditions.name: install-on-installs
preconditions.note: flag ON -> install_three_organ_gate wraps chat.gate on the real production chat

preconditions.name: q3-unanimity-window
preconditions.note: on the shared workspace bridge 2*d_sub=2000->rate=0.030 < THR=0.167 <= 3*d_sub=3000->rate=0.333 (a withheld organ C -> abstain; corroborating -> commit)

preconditions.name: real-vocab-discriminates-known-from-unknown
preconditions.note: organ C corroborates every real-vocab-KNOWN proposition (incl. dog-chase-cat / cat-eat-fish) and vetoes an OOV-entity proposition (wizard/dragon) — the veto fires ONLY on genuine non-comprehension, not on a role-ambiguous surface form

disabled_processes.why: tested at the ChatBrain.gate/combine level where the 3-organ wiring lives, not the heavy numpy-CPU per-turn handler; byte-identical-when-off is guaranteed by construction there (the server hook is gated by the SAME BRAIN_GNW_3ORGAN flag; =0 to skip -> never imported)

the recall composer (both rf and onebrain) is EXACT-MATCH: organ A returns a cand ONLY for a stored (agent, action), so on this path a recalled proposition's entities are always in-vocab and the moat independently abstains on an unknown (agent, action). Organ C's genuine non-comprehension veto is therefore exercised at the _comprehension_vote level (the real vote fn the combine calls) + mapped to abstain via the proven Q=3 window; it becomes a live full-combine guard only when a noisier composer path returns an ungrounded recalled token
